interestingFact: India is the world's largest democracy and is home to the Taj Mahal.
The United States has 50 states and is home to the Grand Canyon.
Japan is made up of thousands of islands and is famous for Mount Fuji.
France is home to the Eiffel Tower and is famous for its art and cuisine.
Australia is the only country that occupies an entire continent.
Brazil contains most of the Amazon rainforest, one of the world's richest ecosystems.
Canada has the longest coastline of any country in the world.
Germany is famous for its engineering, historic castles, and Oktoberfest.
